name: Audio, music & voice
short: Transcribe, speak, sing, separate, and clean audio
description: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, music generation, podcast cleanup, and audio repair tools. Free options cover a surprising range, but time limits, licensing, and whether you may use a voice or song commercially vary enormously.
tip: Only clone or imitate a voice with clear permission. Record everyone's consent before transcribing a meeting. Free music plans often prohibit commercial use, and open-source music models may carry non-commercial weights. Keep the original recording, and treat automated transcripts as drafts.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.signup: Free account; no card. A monthly character allowance and attribution or commercial rules apply.
tools.free: A free monthly character allowance for realistic text-to-speech, plus access to some voice library voices and audio tools.
tools.limits: The free character cap is small, roughly a short audio piece. Voice cloning, commercial terms, higher-quality audio, and more languages/voices require paid plans. Attribution or commercial restrictions can apply.
tools.best_for: Narration samples and accessible voiceovers where you want natural-sounding speech.

tools.name: Murf AI
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Limited monthly generation time and restricted voices apply.
tools.free: A modest free allowance of AI voice generation and access to a selection of voices and editing tools.
tools.limits: Free monthly generation time is limited, some voices and export options are restricted, and commercial use depends on the plan. Higher volume and voice cloning are paid.
tools.best_for: Corporate-style narration, e-learning samples, and voiceover drafts.

tools.name: Speechify
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Standard voices and limited listening features apply.
tools.free: Free text-to-speech listening in the browser and apps using standard voices, with adjustable speed and basic reading features.
tools.limits: Premium voices, offline listening, advanced AI tools, and higher usage are paid. Free features and voice availability change by platform.
tools.best_for: Listening to articles or documents at higher speed when you prefer audio to reading.

tools.name: NaturalReader
tools.signup: Free web or app access; no card. Some uses may require an account; premium voices cost money.
tools.free: Free browser and app text-to-speech with standard voices, document upload, and adjustable reading speed.
tools.limits: Premium voices, offline use, more file formats, and commercial usage require paid plans. Daily or feature limits apply to free accounts.
tools.best_for: Proofreading by ear and accessible reading of PDFs and web pages.

tools.name: Whisper
tools.signup: Install from the official repository; no account or card. Requires Python and local compute.
tools.free: OpenAI's open-source speech-recognition model that can transcribe and translate audio locally with no per-minute service fee.
tools.limits: You need Python, technical setup, and enough compute. Accuracy drops with noise, accents, overlap, and specialist vocabulary. Local use does not automatically make sensitive recordings safe under workplace rules.
tools.best_for: Private transcription, subtitles, and repeatable speech-to-text on your own machine.

tools.name: MacWhisper
tools.signup: Download the free Mac app; no account or card. The free tier excludes advanced features.
tools.free: Free local transcription on macOS with downloaded Whisper-style models, drag-and-drop files, and basic exports.
tools.limits: The free version covers basic local transcription; batch processing, speaker recognition, advanced export, and cloud AI features are paid. Larger models need more memory.
tools.best_for: Mac users who want simple local transcription without a subscription or an upload.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.signup: Free Otter account; no card. Monthly minutes and per-meeting limits apply.
tools.free: Free meeting transcription with a monthly minute allowance, automated summaries, and searchable notes in the web and mobile apps.
tools.limits: Monthly minutes, per-meeting length, advanced search, and team features are capped. Recordings may be processed in the cloud. Get consent before recording other people.
tools.best_for: Meeting notes, interviews, and lectures where a cloud transcript is acceptable.

tools.name: Adobe Podcast Enhance
tools.signup: Free Adobe account; no card. Upload and processing limits apply.
tools.free: Free web-based AI speech enhancement that can reduce room noise and make voice recordings sound clearer.
tools.limits: Requires an Adobe account and is subject to processing time, file, and usage limits. It works best on clean speech; music and badly clipped audio can sound artificial.
tools.best_for: Rescuing voice memos or podcast recordings made in an imperfect room.

tools.name: Suno
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Daily credits, queue restrictions, and non-commercial terms apply.
tools.free: A daily allowance of credits to generate full songs with vocals or instrumentals from a prompt or lyric idea.
tools.limits: Free credits are limited, outputs may carry restrictions, and free-plan songs generally cannot be used commercially. Higher quality, more generations, and ownership/use rights require paid plans.
tools.best_for: Song sketches, creative gifts, and experimenting with lyrics and styles, not commercial releases.

tools.name: Udio
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Monthly credits and download or commercial restrictions apply.
tools.free: Free monthly generation credits for AI music with vocals, style controls, extensions, and song sections.
tools.limits: Free credits are limited, downloads and commercial rights are restricted, and content availability or model policies can change. Paid plans add generations and broader use rights.
tools.best_for: Exploring AI music production and building a rough demo with a specific genre or mood.

tools.name: Stable Audio
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Monthly credits are commonly limited to non-commercial use.
tools.free: Free monthly credits for generating music and sound effects through Stability AI's web tools.
tools.limits: Free generations are capped and typically limited to non-commercial use. Higher volume, commercially usable output, and longer audio require a paid plan or license.
tools.best_for: Short background beds, sound effects, and trying text-to-audio ideas.

tools.name: AudioCraft
tools.signup: Install from the official repository; no account or card. Requires Python and capable hardware.
tools.free: Meta's open-source audio-generation codebase, including MusicGen and AudioGen, for running music and sound models locally.
tools.limits: Requires Python, model downloads, and capable hardware. Model weights and licenses may restrict commercial use. Output quality and control are not the same as polished hosted services.
tools.best_for: Technical experiments with local music and sound-effect generation.

tools.name: Kokoro TTS
tools.signup: Install from the official project; no account or card. You manage packages, models, and hardware.
tools.free: An open-source, compact text-to-speech model and tooling that can run locally with fast, natural-sounding voices.
tools.limits: Requires setup and some technical comfort. Voice options, language support, and hardware performance depend on the package you choose. Check the model and code licenses before commercial use.
tools.best_for: Local narration, accessibility projects, and experimenting with lightweight TTS.

tools.name: TTSMaker
tools.signup: Basic web use needs no account; no card. Per-file and daily character caps apply.
tools.free: Free browser text-to-speech with many voices and languages, no account needed for basic use, and downloadable audio.
tools.limits: There are per-file and daily character caps, some voices are restricted, and features/ads may change. Check the current license for each voice and intended commercial use.
tools.best_for: Quick voiceovers, reading practice clips, and narration samples without software installation.

tools.name: Moises
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Monthly song and separation limits apply.
tools.free: Free stem separation, practice tools, pitch/tempo changes, and AI audio analysis with a limited monthly allowance.
tools.limits: Song uploads, separation minutes, downloads, and advanced features are capped. Commercial use and higher-quality stems need a paid plan; use only audio you have rights to process.
tools.best_for: Making practice tracks, isolating vocals, and studying a song's parts.

tools.name: Ultimate Vocal Remover
tools.signup: Download the official release; no account or card. Requires local install and ideally a GPU.
tools.free: Open-source desktop app for local vocal/instrumental separation, noise reduction, and multi-stem workflows.
tools.limits: Requires installation, preferably a capable GPU, and model downloads. Results vary with source quality, and you must respect the rights of any recording you process.
tools.best_for: Private, repeatable stem separation without per-minute fees.

tools.name: Krisp
tools.signup: Free account; no card. A daily noise-cancellation minute allowance applies.
tools.free: Free AI noise cancellation for calls and recordings with a daily usage allowance on the free plan.
tools.limits: Daily minutes are limited, and advanced meeting notes, transcription, and team features require paid plans. Audio still passes through Krisp's processing pipeline; check policy before sensitive calls.
tools.best_for: Cleaning up fan noise, keyboards, or background chatter during calls and voice recordings.
